description: Number of Buses by Type of Bus in London is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. Number of buses in the TFL fleet by type of bus in London. The fleet size varies slightly from year to year in relation to the placing of route contracts. The hydrogen fuel cell buses are also hybrid. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLS. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
